I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in your direct message. Nothing has been sent; a person still needs to send the draft.

- **What the draft says:** the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 a seat, as Marcus Lindqvist gave it. It says Anselm approved sharing it and asks Hollis to keep it to the people who need it.
- **Why no extra approval was needed:** Hollis is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve the address. Anselm approves per-seat rates himself as CFO.
- **The figure:** I couldn't open any Thornbury files, so $2,101 comes from Anselm's message, not from a document I checked. I told Anselm this in the reply.
